description: Follow-up from bedrock-q67.21.15 (PR #303). The new \xFF/system/logs/<generation>/<log_id> family records :old generation logs so the exclusion check refuses their addresses while recovery may still need them. FDB's updateLogsValue rewrites logsKey without the old vector once those generations drain; Bedrock commits exactly one recovery transaction and has no post-recovery commit path, so :old entries survive until the next recovery replaces them — over-refusing exclusions (safe direction) for the epoch's life. Add the trigger: when the object-storage durable version for every shard passes the recovery version (the point after which no old-generation log can be needed for replay), the distributor (the only mid-epoch system-keyspace writer, under its lock) clears logs/old/ for that generation. Pin with a test that the entries exist after recovery and are gone after durability passes.
title: logs/old/ generation records are never pruned: add a durability trigger that clears them once the object-storage durable version passes the recovery version
